title: Portal Kompetisi Digital
attacker_character: situs tiruan portal lomba, terlihat hampir asli tapi URL berbeda
attacker_goal: memancing korban login dengan email + password sekolah mereka
opener: Masuk dengan akun Google atau email sekolahmu untuk melihat berkas finalis. Catatan: sesi kamu kedaluwarsa, silakan login ulang.
escalation_ladder: error palsu 'password salah' biar korban coba lagi
minta kode verifikasi email 'untuk pemulihan akun'
red_flags: URL beda dengan portal resmi (huruf dobel/tanda hubung)
portal tiba-tiba minta login ulang padahal barusan dipakai
error password terus padahal kamu yakin benar
safe_response: tutup tab, buka portal dari bookmark/resmi, ganti password jika sudah terlanjur masuk, aktifkan 2FA
lesson: Sebelum login, SELALU cek URL. Penipu bikin kembaran portal dengan URL sedikit beda untuk mencuri password. Kode verifikasi tidak perleh dibagikan ke siapa pun.

en.title: Digital Competition Portal
en.attacker_character: fake clone of the contest portal, near-identical look but different URL
en.opener: Sign in with your Google or school email to view your finalist documents. Note: your session expired, please log in again.
escalation_ladder: login page mimicking the real portal
fake 'wrong password' error to make you retry
asks for the email verification code 'for account recovery'
red_flags: URL differs from the official portal (doubled letters/hyphens)
portal suddenly asks to log in again though you just used it
password keeps 'failing' though you're sure it's right
en.safe_response: close the tab, open the portal from your bookmark/official source, change password if you already entered it, enable 2FA
en.lesson: ALWAYS check the URL before logging in. Scammers build near-identical portal clones with slightly different URLs to steal passwords. Verification codes are never to be shared.
